Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria.\nlicense: MIT\n---\n\n# Karpathy Guidelines\n\nBehavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes, derived from [Andrej Karpathy's observations](https://x.com/karpathy/status/2015883857489522876) on LLM coding pitfalls.\n\n**Tradeoff:** These guidelines bias toward caution over speed. For trivial tasks, use judgment.\n\n## 1. Think Before Coding\n\n**Don't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.**\n\nBefore implementing:\n- State your assumptions explicitly. If uncertain, ask.\n- If multiple interpretations exist, present them - don't pick silently.\n- If a simpler approach exists, say so. Push back when warranted.\n- If something is unclear, stop. Name what's confusing. Ask.\n\n## 2. Simplicity First\n\n**Minimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.**\n\n- No features beyond what was asked.\n- No abstractions for single-use code.\n- No \"flexibility\" or \"configurability\" that wasn't requested.\n- No error handling for impossible scenarios.\n- If you write 200 lines and it could be 50, rewrite it.\n\nAsk yourself: \"Would a senior engineer say this is overcomplicated?\" If yes, simplify.\n\n## 3. Surgical Changes\n\n**Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.**\n\nWhen editing existing code:\n- Don't \"improve\" adjacent code, comments, or formatting.\n- Don't refactor things that aren't broken.\n- Match existing style, even if you'd do it differently.\n- If you notice unrelated dead code, mention it - don't delete it.\n\nWhen your changes create orphans:\n- Remove imports/variables/functions that YOUR changes made unused.\n- Don't remove pre-existing dead code unless asked.\n\nThe test: Every changed line should trace directly to the user's request.\n\n## 4. Goal-Driven Execution\n\n**Define success criteria. Loop until verified.**\n\nTransform tasks into verifiable goals:\n- \"Add validation\" → \"Write tests for invalid inputs, then make them pass\"\n- \"Fix the bug\" → \"Write a test that reproduces it, then make it pass\"\n- \"Refactor X\" → \"Ensure tests pass before and after\"\n\nFor multi-step tasks, state a brief plan:\n```\n1. [Step] → verify: [check]\n2. [Step] → verify: [check]\n3. [Step] → verify: [check]\n```\n\nStrong success criteria let you loop independently. Weak criteria (\"make it work\") require constant clarification.\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}

This enables Switch-based merge topologies\n    18\t * where a downstream node binds to nodes on multiple branches — only the\n    19\t * active branch's node will have output; the others gracefully degrade.\n    20\t *\n    21\t * If the referenced node doesn't exist in the workflow at all (not in\n    22\t * `allNodeIds`), that indicates a broken reference and still throws.\n    23\t */\n    24\texport function resolveVariables(\n    25\t  bindings: VariableBinding[],\n    26\t  paramValues: Record<string, unknown>,\n    27\t  nodeOutputs: Record<string, string>,\n    28\t  nodeNames?: Record<string, string>,\n    29\t  allNodeIds?: Set<string>,\n    30\t): ResolveVariablesResult {\n    31\t  const resolved: Record<string, string> = {}\n    32\t  const skippedReferences: ResolveVariablesResult[\"skippedReferences\"] = []\n    33\t\n    34\t  for (const { name, source } of bindings) {\n    35\t    if (source.type === \"param\") {\n    36\t      if (!(source.param in paramValues)) {\n    37\t        logger.warn(\"variable resolved to empty: referenced parameter is missing\", {\n    38\t          variableName: name, paramName: source.param,\n    39\t        })\n    40\t      }\n    41\t      const raw = paramValues[source.param]\n    42\t      const isNaN = typeof raw === \"number\" && Number.isNaN(raw)\n    43\t      resolved[name] = (raw != null && !isNaN) ? String(raw) : \"\"\n    44\t    } else if (source.type === \"node_output\") {\n    45\t      if (!(source.node in nodeOutputs)) {\n    46\t        const displayName = nodeNames?.[source.node] ?? source.node\n    47\t        // If the node exists in the workflow but has no output, it was skipped\n    48\t        // by branch logic. Resolve gracefully to empty string.\n    49\t        if (allNodeIds && allNodeIds.has(source.node)) {\n    50\t          logger.warn(\"variable resolved to empty: source node not available\", {\n    51\t            variableName: name, sourceNodeId: source.node, sourceNodeName: displayName,\n    52\t          })\n    53\t          resolved[name] = \"\"\n    54\t          skippedReferences.push({ variableName: name, sourceNodeId: source.node, sourceNodeName: displayName })\n    55\t        } else {\n    56\t          // Node doesn't exist in the workflow — this is a broken reference\n    57\t          const errorMsg = `变量 $${name} 引用了不存在的节点「${displayName}」`\n    58\t          logger.error(\"variable resolution failed: referenced node does not exist\", {\n    59\t            variableName: name, sourceNodeId: source.node, sourceNodeName: displayName,\n    60\t          })\n    61\t          throw new Error(errorMsg)\n    62\t        }\n    63\t      } else {\n    64\t        resolved[name] = nodeOutputs[source.node]\n    65\t      }\n    66\t    } else {\n    67\t      resolved[name] = source.value\n    68\t    }\n    69\t  }\n    70\t  return { resolved, skippedReferences }\n    71\t}\n    72\t\n    73\t\n    74\texport function interpolatePrompt(template: string, vars: Record<string, string>): string {\n    75\t  // Supports {{varName}} and {{$varName}} with spaces, dots, and hyphens.\n    76\t  return template.replace(/\\{\\{\\s*\\$?([\\p{L}\\p{N}_.-]+)\\s*\\}\\}/gu, (match, n: string) => {\n    77\t    if (!(n in vars)) {\n    78\t      logger.warn(\"unbound template variable\", { variable: n, match })\n    79\t      throw new Error(`模板变量「${n}」未绑定`)\n    80\t    }\n    81\t    return vars[n]\n    82\t  })\n    83\t}\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}

Summary\nAgent 权限请求超时后，自动拒绝如果发送失败会被后台吞掉，pending 权限会先消失，当前 turn 继续等待到会话事件超时。\n\n## Priority\n- Priority: P1\n- Type: errorHandling\n- Direction: B\n- Estimated complexity: small\n\n## Evidence\n用户发送消息触发工具权限请求 → \"'`desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts:403` 在 live turn 中遇到 `permissionRequest`，并在 `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts:404` 等待 `awaitPendingPermission(...)` → `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts:640` 的超时回调调用 `liveSession.respondPermission(... deny ...)`，但该 Promise 只接 `.catch(...)` 记录日志，没有被 await → 同一个回调在 `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts:654` 立即调用 `settlePendingPermission(pending)`。\n\n`settlePendingPermission` 会在 `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/session-manager.ts:260` 到 `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/session-manager.ts:266` 清掉 state 和全局 `pendingPermissions`，并 resolve `awaitPendingPermission`。如果 `respondPermission` 实际发送失败，`desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts:645` 到 `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts:652` 只记录 `Permission timeout auto-deny failed.`，不会把当前 turn 标记失败，也不会保留 pending 给用户重试。\n\n随后 `processLiveTurn` 回到 `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts:384` 的 live event 循环；SDK 侧仍可能卡在未收到权限响应的状态。下一次 `nextLiveEventWithTimeout` 在 `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts:385` 等待默认 5 分钟后，才在 `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts:386` 到 `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts:390` 生成 `Agent session timed out.` 并关闭当前 turn。\n\n## Code References\n- `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts:403`\n- `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts:640`\n- `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts:645`\n- `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts:654`\n- `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/session-manager.ts:260`\n- `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts:385`\n\n## Related Files\n- `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/conversation-router.ts`\n- `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/session-manager.ts`\n- `desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime/agent-runtime-service.ts`\n\n## Impact\n正常 Agent 对话中，只要工具权限卡片超时且 SDK/transport 拒绝响应发送失败，用户会看到权限请求从 pending 列表消失，但会话没有立刻失败或给出可操作错误。当前 turn 会继续占用运行状态，直到 live event 超时后才显示泛化的会话超时，真实失败点也丢失。\n\n## Scope Check\n`rg \"permissionTimeoutMs|Permission request timed out|auto-deny failed|settlePendingPermission'\"\\\\\\\\(pending\\\\\\\\)|awaitPendingPermission\\\\\\\\(\\\" desktop/electron/services/agent-runtime desktop/src/modules/agent\"'` 只找到 `awaitPendingPermission` 的 timeout 分支和用户手动 `respondPermission` 分支；手动分支会 await `pending.liveSession.respondPermission(...)`，timeout 分支不会等待自动拒绝结果。\n\n## Suggested Fix\n让权限超时分支 await 自动 deny 的结果；如果发送失败，应保留 pending 或将当前 turn
